description: Named bboxes (EPSG:2193) for staged pipeline scaling. The active pilot is set in scripts via DEFAULT_PILOT_BBOX_2193 or the --bbox CLI flag.

waitemata_v1.label: Waitemata Local Board (current)
waitemata_v1.notes: Original pilot — 100% of TreeRegisterPoints fall inside this bbox. Used through October 2026.

auckland_isthmus_v1.label: Auckland Isthmus (Waitemata + Albert-Eden + Puketāpapa + Maungakiekie-Tāmaki + Ōrākei + Whau)
auckland_isthmus_v1.notes: Adds the urban isthmus south of Waitemata down to Mt Roskill / Onehunga / Mt Wellington. ~2.5× the Waitemata bbox.

auckland_metro_v1.label: Auckland urban metro (incl. North Shore + Manukau + Waitakere fringe)
auckland_metro_v1.notes: Much larger — needs cloud / overnight compute and pmtiles geographic chunking.
